Pour la version anglaise de cette description de poste, veuillez consulter le lien suivant / For the English version of this job description, please refer to the following link :
 Senior Manager, Web Strategy & AI Experience 
 À propos d’AppDirect 
 Devenez un citoyen du monde à l’ère numérique et outillez une nouvelle génération d’entrepreneurs branchés aux quatre coins du globe. AppDirect offre une plateforme d’abonnement permettant de vendre n’importe quel produit en tant que service, et ce, par n’importe quel canal et sur n’importe quel appareil. Nous alimentons des millions d’abonnements pour le compte d’organisations de partout dans le monde. Notre action est toujours guidée par nos valeurs et notre culture – une culture qui vous permet d’être vu, de rester authentique et d’exceller.
 Votre profil 
 En tant que gestionnaire principal(e), stratégie Web et expérience IA, vous jouerez un rôle de premier plan dans l'élaboration d'expériences numériques engageantes destinées à nos clients, partenaires et parties prenantes. Toutes les expériences débutent sur notre site web, et c'est vous qui en façonnerez la porte d'entrée pour AppDirect et nos marques affiliées : en veillant à ce que les clients potentiels puissent nous trouver, et à ce qu'ils se retrouvent pleinement dans les expériences que vous concevez pour eux.
 Vous combinerez réflexion stratégique et exécution concrète : certains jours, en élaborant une feuille de route qui équilibre les priorités d'affaires et la capacité de l'équipe; d'autres jours, en plongeant dans des défis techniques complexes ou en donnant aux membres de votre équipe les moyens de concrétiser leurs idées grâce à des solutions vibe-codées.
 Vous dirigerez une petite équipe de développement Web agile, responsable des expériences destinées aux clients finaux et aux partenaires, à partir de notre site Web. Vous insufflerez à votre équipe une mentalité axée sur l'IA en priorité : qu'il s'agisse d'intégrer l'IA aux expériences client ou d'accélérer les livrables de l'équipe grâce à l'IA. Vous tirerez parti de la plateforme IA exclusive d'AppDirect (devs.ai) et des environnements de vibe-coding les plus performants pour libérer le potentiel créatif et technique des équipes techniques et non techniques, et accélérer notre délai de mise en marché.
 Ce rôle est hautement transversal. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes marketing, les équipes techniques, les équipes produit et la direction afin de livrer des résultats stratégiques et mesurables. Votre mission ne se limite pas à suivre l'évolution technologique : vous en êtes l'un des moteurs.
 Ce que vous ferez et ce qui vous fera briller 
 Piloter la stratégie, la feuille de route et la mise en œuvre du site Web d’entreprise et des applications Web destinées aux clients d'AppDirect, en assurant leur alignement sur les objectifs commerciaux et les résultats visés.
 Orchestrer l'intégration de l'IA dans les flux de travail de l'équipe : identifier, tester et mettre en place des outils pour accélérer le développement, générer du contenu, créer des prototypes et personnaliser l'expérience utilisateur.
 Développer une stratégie de contenu et de référencement (SEO) optimisée pour les grands modèles de langage, dans le but de garantir la visibilité du contenu numérique auprès des utilisateurs humains et des systèmes d'IA.
 Diriger et mentorer une équipe de développeurs Web travaillant avec les dernières technologies Web et d'IA (nous n’imposons pas d’outils en particulier); définir des normes de rendement et favoriser le développement professionnel.
 Collaborer avec les équipes responsables de la conception et des interfaces pour faire évoluer la bibliothèque de composants et le système de conception, en s’assurant de maintenir la cohérence, l'accessibilité et la réactivité sur tous les points de contact numériques.
 Améliorer la performance du site grâce à l'optimisation technique, aux données structurées, à l'expérimentation et aux tests de conversion.
 Compétences requises 
 5+ années d'expérience en gestion de la stratégie Web, du design ou de la gestion de produits numériques, idéalement dans un environnement SaaS B2B.
 Expérience de travail avec React, Next.js, les infrastructures Web, les outils de programmation intuitive (vibe-coding), les bases de données PostgreSQL et l'architecture Medallion.
 Expérience éprouvée avec l'intégration d'outils d'IA dans les flux de développement ou de contenu, notamment des outils de programmation basés sur l'apprentissage automatique (p. ex., Cursor, Lovable ou Bolt).
 Expérience éprouvée avec l’optimisation SEO, l’optimisation des performances, les données structurées et les stratégies de contenu intégrant l'apprentissage automatique.
 Expérience en gestion d'équipes techniques et d'initiatives interfonctionnelles regroupant membres des équipes des produits, de la conception et du marketing.
 Excellentes compétences en communication : vous devrez traduire des décisions techniques complexes en directives claires pour les partenaires non techniques et la direction.
 À l’aise face à l’ambiguïté et aux méthodes de travail itératives : le paysage de l’IA évolue rapidement et ce rôle exige de constamment réévaluer et redéfinir les priorités, les outils et les approches.
 Chez AppDirect, nous croyons que l’innovation est à son meilleur dans un environnement favorisant la diversité de l’excellence, de l’expérience et de la pensée. Nous accueillons chaque « AppDirecteur » et « AppDirectrice » pour l’empreinte unique qui est la sienne. Nous favorisons un environnement inclusif et sans discrimination à l’égard de la race, de la religion, de l’âge, de l’orientation sexuelle et de l’identité de genre, afin de favoriser l’authenticité, la fierté et l’excellence. Dans cette optique, nous encourageons fortement les candidatures des personnes autochtones, des personnes handicapées, des personnes issues de la diversité des orientations sexuelles et des genres et/ou des personnes aux identités intersectionnelles.
 Chez AppDirect, nous prenons la protection de la vie privée très au sérieux. Pour plus d'informations sur notre utilisation et notre gestion des données personnelles des candidats, veuillez lire notre politique de confidentialité des candidats. Pour en savoir plus sur nos pratiques générales en matière de confidentialité, veuillez consulter l'avis de confidentialité d'AppDirect : https://www.appdirect.com/about/privacy-notice
 L’équipe de recrutement d’AppDirect peut faire appel à des outils d'IA pour l’assister dans l'automatisation des tâches administratives, toujours sous supervision humaine. Ces outils ne prennent aucune décision d'embauche ni aucune décision automatisée concernant votre candidature; toutes les décisions sont prises par nos équipes. En soumettant votre candidature, vous acceptez que vos informations puissent être traitées de cette manière. Vous pouvez à tout moment demander l'accès à vos données ou leur suppression en écrivant à privacy@appdirect.com.

Tutor Me Education is looking for an outstanding communicator and relationship manager to serve as the primary point of contact for families, students, and instructors in our Special Education Tutoring program. This role is about case management, not instruction — you'll be the calm, organized, professional voice that keeps families informed, schedules running smoothly, and everyone feeling taken care of. Strong candidates from customer service, account management, hospitality, or virtual operations backgrounds are encouraged to apply as long as they have some educational experience.
 What You'll Do 
 Serve as the primary relationship manager for a caseload of families — building trust, answering questions, and being their go-to contact
 Conduct intake calls with new families and set expectations clearly and confidently
 Build and manage class schedules across multiple students, teachers, and platforms
 Communicate proactively with families about scheduling, progress, and any concerns — via phone, video, and written correspondence
 Monitor student progress and flag concerns to the appropriate specialist
 Coordinate with instructors to ensure sessions run smoothly
 Navigate multiple software systems daily (scheduling platforms, spreadsheets, video conferencing, CRM/case management tools) without missing a beat
 Represent Tutor Me Education professionally in every interaction — you are often the face of the company to our families
 Support basic oversight of IEP/504 accommodation compliance (full training provided — deep SPED expertise not required)
 What We're Looking For (in priority order) 
 Outstanding communicator. You speak clearly, confidently, and warmly — on the phone, on video, and in writing. You can deliver hard news to a frustrated parent without sounding defensive, and you make people feel heard.
 Tech-comfortable and virtual-ready. You show up to virtual meetings with a working camera and headset, a quiet professional space, and you move between multiple platforms (spreadsheets, scheduling tools, video conferencing) without friction.
 A true professional who represents our brand well. You're organized, reliable, and composed under pressure. Families and school partners should always come away with a great impression of our company because of you.
 Special education experience strongly preferred. Direct experience with IEPs, 504 plans, or students with disabilities is a significant advantage and will be weighted favorably. Candidates with strong general education or tutoring experience — and exceptional performance on 1-3 above — will also be considered. All candidates should be ready to build fluency with IEP/504 basics, academic frameworks, and case management systems.
 Excellent verbal and written English communication skills — required, and heavily assessed in our interview process
 Reliable high-speed internet, a working webcam, and a headset/microphone for virtual meetings
 Comfortable learning and using multiple software platforms (Google Workspace/Microsoft Office required; scheduling and CRM tools trained on the job)
 Prior experience in a remote/virtual role strongly preferred
 Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities independently
 Customer service, account management, or client-facing experience preferred
 Bachelor's degree preferred, not required
 Some experience in an educational setting required (school, tutoring, or similar) — experience with special education, IEPs, or students with disabilities is strongly preferred
 Bilingual English/Spanish a plus
 Fully Remote!
 PTO
 Etc.

 After the onsite training period at our Ottawa Home Office this role will be able to be flexible: the employee can work remotely, or onsite. There will be some travel to store and other GT locations on an as needed basis for issues that cannot be resolved remotely.

 Manage and prioritize Tier 2 tickets, project tasks, onsite assignments, and other responsibilities from assignment through completion, adhering to Giant Tiger processes, procedures, service expectations, and agreed timelines, while coordinating dependencies, and keeping appropriate stakeholders informed.

 Carry the after-hours pager as scheduled and respond to Tier 2 incidents and service requests in accordance with Giant Tiger after-hours processes and procedures.
 Create and maintain Tier 2 knowledge base articles and technical documentation, and share newly acquired knowledge with the Help Desk and 2nd Line team.

 Ability to follow written processes and procedures with a high level of attention to detail.
 Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and information-gathering skills.
 Experience using an ITSM system such as ServiceNow or FreshService.

 Ability and willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies and expand technical knowledge across the areas supported by the 2nd Line team.
 Reliability and punctuality are required.
 Assets You May Have: 
 ITIL 4 Foundation Certification.
 Network+ Certification or higher.
 Previous experience working with CCTV technologies.
 Previous experience working with firewalls and switches.
 Previous experience working with Audio/Visual equipment.
 Previous experience supporting telephony, paging/music, networking, store infrastructure, or multi-site retail technology environments.
 Experience coordinating technical work with third-party vendors or subcontractors.
 Previous work experience in a customer service role.

About Flosum 
Every large company now runs critical parts of its business on Salesforce: sales, service, financial data, patient records, citizen services. When a release breaks something or data goes missing, revenue stops and regulators call. Flosum is the platform these companies trust to ship changes safely, protect their data, and recover fast.
We are in the middle of the most exciting chapter in our history. Our customers have relied on our Salesforce-native platform for years. Now we are bringing them a new cloud-native platform they can run on AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or on-premises. We have also launched sandbox management built for the AI era, so teams can test AI agents such as Agentforce on production-ready environments in minutes instead of days.
Our customers include some of the most demanding enterprises in banking, insurance, healthcare, the public sector, and technology. They don’t buy us casually, and they don’t leave us casually. Your job is to make sure they never want to.
 The role 
You will own a book of enterprise accounts and one number: retained revenue. You decide which accounts need you most this week, and you go there. This is a commercial role. You will spend your time with executives, not running support tickets.
 What you will do 
 Own renewals across your book, from strategic accounts to smaller ones, and protect every dollar of recurring revenue.
 Build relationships with the executives who decide: CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and heads of Salesforce platforms. Reach past your champion when the account needs it.
 Turn red accounts green. Spot risk early, build a save plan, and run it with urgency.
 Move customers from our Salesforce-native products to our cloud-native platform, and make the business case for why it matters to them.
 Defend your accounts against competitors, in-house builds, and new enterprise architectures.
 Pull the right people in. Hold product, support, engineering, and customer success accountable for what your customers need.
 Find expansion opportunities and hand them to our sales team with a clear plan.
 Run your book with discipline: accurate forecasts, clean renewal pipeline in Salesforce, no surprises.
 What you bring
 7+ years in enterprise account management, renewals, or customer-facing sales at a B2B software company.
 You have carried a significant book of business (ideally $5M+ in annual recurring revenue) with individual accounts above $250K.
 You have sold or renewed complex IT solutions: DevOps, data protection, security, infrastructure, or developer platforms. Technical buyers trust you.
 A track record of saving at-risk renewals by going to the executive level, with the numbers to prove it.
 Commercial intensity. You negotiate well, you push for multi-year terms, and you are comfortable with hard conversations about price and value.

 Clear, concise writing and speaking. You can brief a CIO in five minutes.
 Experience in the Salesforce ecosystem is a strong plus.
 Why join now 
 You will work with customers at the moment they move to the cloud. Few account managers get to shape a transition this large.
 Our products sit in the path of AI adoption. Every company deploying AI agents on Salesforce needs to test, release, and protect them safely.
 You will have real ownership, direct access to leadership, and the room to build how account management works here.
 Competitive base plus variable compensation tied to retention.

Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $169 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.



We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/culture and learn more about how we work https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/careers.



About the team:

At Wealthsimple, we aren't just managing portfolios; we're rewriting the rules of how Canadians interact with credit. The Credit Analytics team own’s Wealthsimple's lending ecosystem, operating at the intersection of high-growth tech and data-driven underwriting.



We believe that being “credit-worthy” should mean more than just a traditional score. Our mission is to challenge the status quo, building inclusive products that empower millions of Canadians and the businesses they run to lead better financial lives. We’re growing fast, moving from small data to massive scale through iteration and experimentation.



We are extending our consumer credit expertise into business lending built for Canadian small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs). This is a true green-field build — new adjudication policy, new underwriting signals, and new risk infrastructure, informed by everything we've learned scaling our consumer card portfolio.



About the role:

We are looking for a Senior Associate to own credit policy for our business lending products, starting with a business credit card — from adjudication through the full account lifecycle. You will design and implement the underwriting framework that determines who qualifies and at what limit, build the line management strategies that govern how those limits evolve, and partner closely with collections to manage risk once accounts are on book.



Small business cards can be underwritten on the owner, or on the business as it grows. You’ll be working with cash flow, seasonality, industry, and business bureau data, which is usually thinner and messier than consumer bureau data. We need someone who has worked across that range and can turn it into automated policy instead of file-by-file decisions.



You will collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Data Science, Fraud, and Client Experience to translate policy into shippable adjudication and monitoring systems, and you will have significant ownership over how this portfolio’s risk appetite is defined from day one.



In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

 - Build a new lending program from the ground up with the breadth to see every part of it, from policy to funding, and the runway to grow into leading a lending line of business.

 - Design and own the adjudication policy for a new business credit card, including entity-level underwriting criteria, principal/guarantor assessment, joint-liability, initial limit-setting, and approval decisioning.

 - Own line management strategy for business credit products: credit limit increases and decreases, pricing, authorization rules, and active exposure management driven by cash-flow and balance monitoring.

 - Partner with the collections team to design risk-managed treatment strategies specific to business accounts, and to build lifecycle monitoring that catches emerging risk early.

 - Evaluate the performance of the business lending portfolio and your policies, using vintage analysis, cohort tracking, and champion/challenger testing to validate and refine underwriting decisions.

 - Propose policy enhancements that improve marginal profitability while keeping risk within appetite, informed by rigorous root-cause analysis rather than surface-level metrics.

 - Help define the data and underwriting infrastructure needed for SMB lending — including how to source, validate, and weigh business financial data alongside traditional bureau signals.

 - Influence roadmaps across partner teams (Engineering, Product, Data Science, Fraud, and Client Experience) and implement policy that drives measurable impact.

We're looking for someone who:

 - Has direct experience underwriting or setting credit policy for small and medium-sized businesses, this is a must-have for this role. Card experience isn't required; we'd love to hear from you if your background is in instalment loans or lines of credit.

 - Writes SQL hands-on to self-serve data and build monitoring and analytics.

 - Brings credit discipline to a ship-and-iterate environment, and is comfortable shaping policy while the product itself is still being defined.

 - Can turn analysis into a clear recommendation for technical and non-technical audiences, weigh incomplete or noisy information and still reach well-grounded decisions.

 - Is intellectually curious, passionate about their work, and wants ownership over their projects.

Preferred qualifications:

 - 5+ years of experience in small business lending

 - Knowledge of Canadian consumer credit bureau data (Equifax, TransUnion)

About Behavox 
 Behavox is a cloud-native AI company providing an integrated controls platform for global banks, asset managers, hedge funds, private equity firms, insurance businesses, and commodity firms. The platform unifies communications and trade surveillance, compliant archiving, policy management as well as front-office analytics on a single, AI-native technology stack, delivered as a globally scalable SaaS-based cloud service.
 At Behavox, our engineering culture is built around speed, experimentation, and technical excellence, following agile principles and rapid iteration. We constantly test and adopt the latest cloud technologies and AI tooling, optimising for fast feedback loops and execution. We look for people who can move fast, challenge conventional wisdom, and who want to work at the frontier of modern AI, SaaS platforms, and distributed systems.
 Behavox is a high-performance organisation with a strong bias toward delivery, ownership, and responsibility. We commit, and we execute. We are building systems that are complex, mission-critical, and global in scale; systems that many consider too large or too difficult. To do that, we seek the smartest, most technically capable engineers and technologists who take end-to-end responsibility and want to win by building what others cannot.
 Founded in 2014 and backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Behavox is headquartered in London, with offices worldwide, including New York City, Montreal, Seattle, Singapore, and Tokyo.
 About the Role 
 The Senior FP&A Analyst owns Behavox's core financial model — its architecture, the accounting beneath it, and the forecasts and analysis the company plans and decides by. The role exists to change decisions, not report them: it turns the numbers into the choices leadership actually faces. It reads and integrates budgets into the model, but does not run the budgeting cycle.
 The same analyst builds the valuations, scenarios, and pro-forma models behind every acquisition — evaluating targets, running diligence, and folding closed deals into a single consolidated view. This work is periodic and must be carried alone when it arrives; the steady state is the operating model and SaaS forecasting.
 This is a high-autonomy role that works without a detailed brief and sets the modeling standard others build on. It is accountable for the accuracy and integrity of the numbers, and for turning them into recommendations sharp enough to act on — the downside case included, not just the point estimate — for senior leadership, the board, and investors. It pressure-tests the assumptions behind every result, works fluently with modern tooling and AI, and compounds that edge by learning relentlessly. Its influence comes from the rigor and reach of the analysis, not from authority: it owns the model and the truth it tells, not the decisions made from it.
 What You'll Bring 
 Financial Model & Accounting Foundations — Knows how an integrated three-statement and operating model fits together, and the accounting that holds it up — SaaS revenue recognition and cost treatment included. Understands exactly how the company's budgets are built, and folds them into the model.
 Forecasting & SaaS Unit Economics — Knows both bottom-up short-term forecasting and driver-based long-term modeling, and the SaaS metrics that actually reveal performance. Knows what moves each one and which lever changes it — not just how to report it.
 Mergers, Acquisitions & Integration — Knows how to value an acquisition and how to fold it into one consolidated model: purchase accounting, combined-entity projections, and the mechanics that make or break the integration.
 Business & Commercial Acumen — Knows in depth how the business and every function make money — the revenue drivers, the cost structure, the operating levers — and spots a number that doesn't add up on sight.
 Financial Systems & AI Tooling — Commands Google Sheets and Excel, and tracks the AI and automation landscape closely enough to know where it is trustworthy and where it isn't.
 What You'll Do 
 Financial Model Ownership — Builds and maintains the core three-statement and operating model with scenario and sensitivity layers, and keeps it accurate, clean, and easy to maintain. Integrates budgets without owning the cycle, and owns the accuracy of every output and the integrity of every assumption.
 Acquisition Modeling & Integration — Builds the valuations, scenarios, and pro-forma combined-entity models behind acquisition evaluation and due diligence, and folds closed deals into a single consolidated view.
 Business-Review Reporting — Drives much of the substance of the monthly, quarterly, and annual business reviews — with the broader FP&A team — for senior management, the board, and investors, turning the model into a narrative that explains what moved the results and what it means for the business.
 Metrics Analysis & Business Partnering — Diagnoses why the metrics are moving and which lever changes them, pressure-tests the assumptions behind every result, and hands the decision-maker a recommendation they can act on.
 AI-Enabled Productivity — Uses AI and spreadsheet automation to compress cycle time and harden data validation — automating the recurring work while keeping judgment on what stays manual.
 What We Offer 
 The opportunity to work on a global, mission-critical AI platform alongside the best engineers and technologists across multiple geographies.
 A role with real ownership and impact, building complex systems at scale in an environment that values speed, experimentation, and technical excellence.
 A highly attractive benefits package, including competitive cash compensation, and an equity award aligned with long-term value creation.
 Modern, comfortable offices in Toronto and Montreal. This is a hybrid role (1 day in office). 
 A generous time-off policy of 30 days annually, plus public holidays and sick leave, recognizing the importance of sustained high performance.
 About Our Process 
 We take Talent very seriously and we are building a community of extraordinary individuals working together in very high performing teams. We also know that the best Talent always has options so we believe that the process has to be a two way assessment - the company AND the candidate assessing the business needs alignment, the career next step alignment, and the cultural alignment. 
During the process we will begin by exploring the core factors regarding salary and location along with core experience and skills and values alignment. We will then deep dive explore the critical technical competencies we have identified for the role, and then we will deep dive in behavioral competencies.
The most aligned candidate will then be asked to do a practical work task simulation activity so we can make sure that you will enjoy the kind of work the role requires, and this task will typically be presented and discussed with a group of colleagues and managers. Finally we will ask you to meet with a number of our senior leaders to make sure that you are making the most informed call possible. 
 Please note that: 
 We want to get to know you and have a genuine conversation, so the use of AI tools or assistance during live interviews is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate disqualification from the process 
 Interviews may be recorded for internal review purposes to ensure fairness and enable collaborative hiring discussions within the team.

We are looking for a Self-Driving Systems Specialist (SDS Specialist) to support the diagnostics, calibration, configuration, and technical readiness of self-driving systems used in autonomous vehicles and robotaxi fleets across North America.
The SDS Specialist focuses on the technology layer of autonomous mobility: sensors, compute systems, software configurations, autonomous driving hardware, system diagnostics, calibration procedures, and technical validation. This role ensures that the self-driving system installed in each autonomous vehicle is functioning correctly, accurately calibrated, and ready to support safe testing, commercial deployment, and autonomous ride-hailing operations.
You will work closely with Senior Technicians, AV Operations Leads, Safety Operators, Depot Specialists, engineering teams, and fleet operations teams to identify technical issues, execute structured troubleshooting procedures, and support reliable operation of autonomous vehicle platforms.

Procurify is the agentic procurement platform that helps mid-market organizations get complete control over their spend.
We’re trusted by hundreds of companies around the world, across industries like biotechnology, education, health care, manufacturing, and software, to manage over $100B in spend.

Product marketing sits at the center of how we're understood in that market, and we're hiring a Director to lead it.




ABOUT THE ROLE



Procurify is looking for a Director of Product Marketing to define how we compete and win. You'll own the company narrative, the messaging architecture our go-to-market organization builds on, how we segment and prioritize the market, and the analyst relationships that influence how Procurify is understood.



This is a chance to help define Procurify's next stage of growth as the agentic procurement platform. You'll be at the center of translating that strategy into positioning, messaging, assets, and programs that drive demonstrable impact across our go-to-market organization.



This is a senior seat on the marketing leadership team, with full visibility across the company and regular engagement with executives. You'll lead two Product Marketing Managers. You'll raise their craft, sharpen their judgment, and expand what they're capable of owning, building both the team's impact and their careers as leaders in their own right.



This is a true player-coach role. Your PMMs own their product portfolios, and you'll guide their strategy and raise the quality of their work while directly owning company-level and cross-portfolio initiatives yourself. It's hands-on by design: you get the scope and influence of a senior leader while staying close to the craft.



AI fluency is table stakes for this role. We expect AI to be foundational to how you analyze information, build workflows, create and evaluate work, and scale the team's impact without compromising quality.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES




POSITIONING AND MARKET STRATEGY

 - Own Procurify's positioning strategy and define how we differentiate in the procurement market.

 - Build and maintain the company-level narrative and messaging architecture as the single source of truth across all surfaces, and translate it into positioning teams can execute against.

 - Own the AI and agentic narrative: make the platform's intelligence concrete, credible, and differentiated for finance and operations buyers.

 - Own market segmentation and use it to direct where we invest and who we talk to.

 - Own the voice of the customer with deep customer research and win/loss analysis.

 - Use product, customer, funnel, and market data to identify patterns, test assumptions, and turn evidence into clear strategic recommendations.

 - Shape Procurify's analyst relations strategy and narrative, building credible relationships with top-tier analyst firms and influencing how the company and category are represented.

 - Act as a credible external voice on procurement and the agentic shift through analyst briefings, press, and webinars.


GO-TO-MARKET

 - Set the execution standard and quality bar for the function, along with the operating rhythms that keep it consistent.

 - Own launch strategy across the portfolio and decide which messages and formats get tested in the market, in partnership with demand generation.

 - Own the strategy for direct-to-customer communications: launch and product-news emails, in-app posts, in-app tours, and lifecycle journeys.

 - Report and analyze product marketing's contribution to pipeline, adoption, and retention.


AI-FIRST PRACTICE

 - Build an AI-enabled Product Marketing practice that improves the quality, consistency, and scale of the function.

 - Establish shared tools, context, and repeatable workflows across core PMM work, and partner with Marketing’s AI specialists to make Product Marketing a model for effective AI-assisted work.


INTERNAL ALIGNMENT AND ENABLEMENT

 - Influence the roadmap, pricing, packaging, and launch sequencing with market, customer, and competitive insight.

 - Own the enablement deliverable set for each product portfolio with your PMMs, including positioning one-pagers, battlecards, playbooks, demo narratives, and objection handling, maintained as living resources in our library rather than launch-day artifacts.

 - Train Sales and Customer Success on messaging, use cases, and differentiation.

 - Set the standard for how competitive intelligence gets gathered and used by go-to-market teams.


TEAM LEADERSHIP AND COACHING

 - Coach two Product Marketing Managers: raise their craft, give direct feedback, hold a high bar on the work, and map a clear path to their next level.

 - Own the team's structure, culture, and operations: the processes, templates, and shared standards that keep output consistent across portfolios, whoever is doing the work.

 - Own the team's plan: what it takes on each quarter, what it defers, and how portfolio coverage is split across the two PMMs.
   
   


EXPERIENCE

 - 10+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with significant Product Marketing leadership experience and direct people management.

 - You’ve owned company-level positioning and messaging for a multi-product or complex SaaS platform, including a meaningful repositioning, category shift, or evolution in market narrative.

 - You’ve led go-to-market strategy across a product portfolio, from segmentation and launch strategy through sales enablement, customer communications, and market adoption.

 - You know how to turn customer, competitive, win/loss, and market insight into decisions on positioning, roadmap, pricing, packaging, and where the business invests.

 - You’ve built credibility with senior executives, Sales, Product, Customer Success, customers, and industry analysts, and can influence decisions without relying on organizational authority.

 - You’ve built and coached a high-performing Product Marketing team, raised the quality bar for the function, and helped marketers meaningfully grow their craft and careers.

 - You’re commercially minded and comfortable measuring Product Marketing against business outcomes, including pipeline, adoption, retention, and competitive performance.

 - You’re AI-fluent in practice, not theory. You’ve changed how a team works using AI, built repeatable workflows around it, and can point to meaningful improvements in the quality or scale of the work.

 - You are an exceptional writer and storyteller who still does the work yourself. You can turn a complex platform into differentiated, credible language that a CFO can understand and repeat.

 - You maintain an up-to-date LinkedIn profile and ensure it is refreshed upon joining, to reflect your role at Procurify and help maintain a consistent, professional presence across our GTM team.
   
   


WHY PROCURIFY?




WE’RE BUILDING A PRODUCT THAT MATTERS.

Procurify is redefining how organizations manage spend - transforming a historically manual, reactive process into a strategic advantage. Today, hundreds of companies trust us to manage billions in spend, and we’re just getting started.



With fresh investment, a strong product foundation, and big ambitions in AI and payments, we’re entering our next phase of growth. That means a real opportunity to shape what we build, how we scale, and the impact we have on our customers.



The best part? The team. We’re a group of builders who move fast, think big, and show up for each other. No egos, no passengers, just people who want to do great work and win together.

Why join us 
 Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.
 Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.
 Finance at Brex 
 The Finance team is a strategic engine at Brex. We lead planning, forecasting, capital allocation, and ROI analysis — partnering across the business to drive clarity and unlock opportunity. We partner across teams at Brex to ensure our business is building and planning with the same dream big goals throughout our entire organization. We’re not here to report on outcomes; we shape them. If you want to influence company direction and think long-term about value creation, this is where your ownership starts. 
 Cross-functional alignment: We work on complex problems that cut across Engineering, Product, Design, Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, CX, and more. This requires the ability to generate buy-in from a wide set of stakeholders on key initiatives
 Business intelligence: We are a data-driven organization that always provides data to support our decision-making. When data is not available, we find it in market and competitive research. We convey complex financial information to varied stakeholders in order to influence decisions.
 Problem solving: We lead with solutions by defining an ambiguous problem, processing information, applying judgment and creativity, and generating buy-in around the answer. This requires the ability to not only track and improve key metrics, but to define what those key metrics should be.
 Building, not just advising: We ship the models, tooling, and automation that the frameworks depend on, and we own their accuracy.
 Where you’ll work 
 This role will be based in our Vancouver office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!
 What You’ll Do 
 We are building out the Strategic Finance team and looking for someone to join the function and partner with leadership to maximize ROI from our investments.
 In this role, you will own the frameworks Brex uses to underwrite and measure return on investment across the business. You will translate roadmap proposals, GTM investments, headcount requests, and pricing changes into expected return, payback, and opportunity cost, so that business partners and Finance underwrite decisions off the same set of numbers. You will work with leaders across the company, and you will close the loop after the fact, measuring realized return against what was originally underwritten.
 You will bring both the financial and the commercial point of view, and need to embrace challenges and structure complex problems. This role carries high exposure to Executive Leadership, as you will regularly deliver analysis and recommendations directly to the Leadership team.
 Responsibilities 
 Build and own the frameworks used to evaluate investment decisions across the business, spanning R&D, GTM, headcount, and pricing
 Partner with business leaders on capital allocation: sizing the cost of a given bet, pricing the tradeoffs between competing uses of the next dollar, and framing opportunity cost in terms leadership can act on
 Develop the unit economics and ROI measurement standards applied to new product launches, pricing changes, GTM programs, and platform investments
 Run post-investment measurement on major bets, comparing realized return to what was underwritten and feeding those learnings back into the framework
 Quantify the downstream commercial impact of product and GTM decisions on revenue, margin, and customer lifetime value
 Translate operating and capacity inputs into financial impact, and financial constraints into terms business partners can plan against
 Build shared definitions and a single source of truth across Finance, EPD, GTM, and Revenue Operations so all organizations plan off the same numbers
 Ship the models, dashboards, and automation the frameworks depend on, and own their accuracy
 Provide ad hoc analytical support to GTM Finance and Revenue Operations on pipeline, conversion, retention, expansion, and go-to-market efficiency questions
 Requirements 
 Bachelor’s Degree in Economics, Finance, Business, or related field
 2+ years of Strategic Finance, FP&A, or Investment Banking experience
 An AI-first mindset: you default to asking how AI can improve every workflow, you actively experiment with new tools, and you have used AI to accelerate analysis or automate a task
 Mastery of Excel and PowerPoint with proven experience in building financial models and managing complex data 
 Strong communication, team-working, quantitative and analytical skills
 Intellectual curiosity, a collaborative work style, and the drive to take ownership in a fast-moving environment
 Comfort managing multiple workstreams simultaneously and proactively driving work forward without being asked
 A bias toward proactive insight over reactive reporting
 Ability to operate independently, build structure in ambiguous environments, and prioritize effectively
 Comfort working directly in data: SQL or BI tooling experience is a strong plus (Snowflake, Hex, Looker, or Salesforce)
 Compensation 
 The expected salary range for this role is $104,000-$130,000 CAD however, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package

La lutte contre le changement climatique est une priorité mondiale. En tant qu’entreprise dont la technologie est utilisée pour alimenter environ 25 % de l’électricité dans le monde, nous prenons notre responsabilité au sérieux. GE Vernova est une entreprise qui prend part à une nouvelle ère énergétique – électrifiant le monde tout en travaillant à le décarboniser. Nous accélérons la transition vers une énergie plus fiable, abordable et durable, tout en aidant nos clients à alimenter des économies et à fournir l'électricité essentielle à la santé, à la sûreté, à la sécurité et à l'amélioration de la qualité de vie.
L'activité Hydroélectrique de GE Vernova conçoit, développe, fabrique et entretient des technologies avancées qui exploitent la puissance de l'eau pour fournir une énergie fiable et durable. Depuis plus d’un siècle, l’hydroélectricité joue un rôle essentiel dans les systèmes électriques nord-américains et mondiaux. Aujourd’hui, il s’agit de la plus grande source d’énergie renouvelable au monde, et la technologie pompage-turbinage représenta la plus grande source de stockage d’énergie. Mais pour atteindre zéro émission nette à l’échelle mondiale d’ici 2050, nous devons doubler la quantité d’hydroélectricité existante. Que ce soit par pompage-turbinage, au fil de l’eau ou en mettant à niveau la base installée existante, l’hydroélectricité continuera d’être la pierre angulaire de l’avenir énergétique de l’Amérique du Nord.

 L’occasion: 
 Nous cherchons à pourvoir un poste de gestionnaire du programme d’absences autorisées et de mesures d’adaptation au sein de notre équipe Personnes et culture.

Il s’agit d’une occasion de façonner un domaine très délicat et important de l’expérience du personnel en établissant des cadres, une gouvernance, des flux de travail, un suivi et des rapports évolutifs, tout en veillant à ce que l’administration quotidienne du programme soit effectuée de manière rigoureuse, uniforme et conforme. 
 La personne retenue aura l’occasion de bâtir et d’améliorer l’infrastructure du programme, d’améliorer les processus et la gouvernance, et de fournir des conseils de confiance aux gestionnaires, aux partenaires des RH, aux membres du personnel et aux fournisseurs externes. En travaillant au sein d’une équipe Personnes et culture qui met l’accent sur la collaboration, vous aiderez à créer une expérience plus fluide, conforme et axée sur le personnel pour les personnes qui composent avec des congés, des mesures d’adaptation et la réintégration au travail, tout en veillant à ce que le programme soit maintenu, administré et surveillé efficacement, en plus de faire l’objet d’améliorations continuelles. 
 En tant qu’uneaviso : 
 Nous prenons soin de vous – Vous faites ce qu’il faut pour la clientèle, les partenaires et les collègues. Vous établissez des relations de confiance, prônez l’excellence du service et contribuez à une culture où chaque personne se sent valorisée et soutenue. 
 Nous osons – Vous remettez en question le statu quo au moyen d’idées audacieuses et de nouvelles perspectives. Vous accueillez le changement, recherchez des occasions d’innovation et êtes à l’aise avec l’exploration de nouvelles méthodes de travail. 
 Nous nous surpassons – Vous collaborez ouvertement et établissez des relations significatives. Vous recherchez des points de vue variés, partagez vos connaissances et travaillez de concert avec les collègues, la clientèle et les partenaires pour les aider à réussir. 
 Nous livrons des résultats – Vous assumez la responsabilité de votre travail, respectez vos engagements et vous concentrez sur la production de résultats concrets. Vous êtes responsable de vos actions et cherchez constamment à vous améliorer. 
 À quoi ressemble votre journée: 
 Diriger l’évolution continue du programme d’absences autorisées et de mesures d’adaptation au travail, qui comprendra la recherche d’occasions de moderniser les processus, d’améliorer l’expérience du personnel, de renforcer la gouvernance et d’harmoniser les pratiques avec les objectifs organisationnels.
 Superviser la réception des demandes, la coordination des dossiers, la documentation et la résolution de cas complexes d’absences, d’invalidité et de mesures d’adaptation, notamment la planification du retour au travail et la mise en œuvre de mesures d’adaptations appropriées au lieu de travail.
 Fournir des conseils de spécialiste aux gestionnaires, aux RH et aux membres du personnel sur les droits aux absences, les exigences en matière d’adaptation et les obligations en matière de conformité.
 Fournir des conseils et administrer toutes les absences prévues par la loi, en veillant à ce que les membres du personnel et les gestionnaires reçoivent des directives claires et à ce que les processus relatifs aux absences soient gérés de façon uniforme et conformément aux lois applicables.
 Élaborer et maintenir des politiques, des procédures et des flux de travail pour assurer la prestation uniforme, conforme et efficace du programme.
 Veiller au respect des normes d’emploi, des lois, des droits de la personne, de l’invalidité, de la confidentialité et des exigences en matière de santé au travail, tout en atténuant le risque pour l’organisation.
 Collaborer avec les parties prenantes internes et les fournisseurs externes pour coordonner une gestion efficace des cas et résoudre les transmissions à un échelon supérieur.
 Surveiller les activités, les tendances et les résultats du programme, notamment en assumant la responsabilité du suivi des mesures du programme et de la préparation de rapports réguliers pour soutenir la prestation des services, renforcer la gouvernance et améliorer l’expérience du personnel.
 Requirements 
 Expérience et compétences demandées : 
 Diplôme de premier cycle en ressources humaines, en administration des affaires, en gestion des invalidités liées à la santé au travail ou dans un domaine connexe. Titre de conseiller·ère en ressources humaines agréé·e (CRHA), de leader en ressources humaines agréé·e (LRHA), de Certified Disability Management Professional (CDMP) ou titre connexe, un atout.
 Au moins sept ans d’expérience pertinente en RH, dont trois à cinq ans dans le domaine des absences autorisées, de la gestion des invalidités ou des mesures d’adaptation au travail.
 Solide connaissance de la législation applicable en matière d’emploi, des obligations en matière de droits de la personne, des principes de gestion des invalidités, des exigences en matière de protection des renseignements personnels et des pratiques de retour au travail.
 Expérience de la gestion de cas complexes d’employé·e·s, avec des compétences organisationnelles exceptionnelles et une conscience du risque, ainsi que capacité de s’adapter à l’évolution des besoins d’affaires, de gérer des priorités concurrentes et de produire des résultats dans un environnement dynamique à volume élevé.
 Capacité démontrée à gérer des dossiers de nature hautement délicate et confidentielle avec grande discrétion, un jugement solide et un respect strict des exigences juridiques et de la protection des renseignements personnels.
 Capacité démontrée à élaborer des politiques, des processus et des cadres de programme dans un environnement organisationnel réglementé ou complexe.
 Maîtrise de l’anglais pour communiquer efficacement avec les partenaires, la clientèle et les collègues partout au Canada; compétences en français, un atout.

 Fort d’un actif total sous administration et sous gestion environ 145 milliards de dollars, et d’un effectif de plus de 1 000 employés, Aviso est un important fournisseur de services de gestion de patrimoine et de placement pour le secteur financier canadien.
